title: Mālama Kula green waste and fire fuel work
summary: As of April 2026, the director says Mālama Kula, founded after the 2023 Kula fire, has removed nearly 2 million pounds of dead and downed trees. In December 2024, the group's Kula green waste bins had removed over 950 cubic yards, and its leader said $250,000 would fund a year of the program, or $300,000 at aspirational levels. The County planned to finalize its own bin contract in January 2025, gather data, then seek budget support for an in-house program.
